targetEvidence: ../batch-125/jmdict-selected-records.xml entries 1359800 and 1359850; ../batch-125/kanjidic2-selected-records.xml; captured Digital Daijisen 侵 as summarized in source-receipt.json
pairSemantics: A guard conservatively excludes a direct pair in either direction; it does not assert universal synonymy or infer exclusions transitively.

dispositions.title: loss; damage
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 損: damage, loss, hurt, injure; JMdict 1406660, 1406690, 1596510; 侵す 1359800: harm, afflict.
dispositions.reason: Damage or harm is a defensible broad 侵 answer, while invade/encroach is not a general translation of loss; protect both directions.

dispositions.title: abbreviate; omit
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 略: capture, plunder; JMdict 1551960 略す sense 3 take/capture/steal without archaic tag, 1552020 略取 and 1606250 略奪; 侵す 1359800 raid.
dispositions.reason: A raid may involve capture or plunder; protect the broad raid-taking choice in either direction. The displayed abbreviation title is not proof against secondary overlap, and 侵略 does not automatically allocate invasion to 略.

dispositions.title: battle
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 戦: war, battle, match; JMdict 1587140, 2080730, 1596960, 1390360 distinguish battle/war from competition; 侵す 1359800 raid.
dispositions.reason: Raid and battle may both describe fighting. Guard broad armed-conflict choices in either direction without equating invasion, war and competition or relying on another card's exclusions.

dispositions.title: endure; surpass
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 凌: endure, keep out, stave off, tide over, defy, slight, surpass; JMdict 1554200 凌ぐ, 1606270 凌駕, 1618720 凌辱.
dispositions.reason: 凌ぐ supports enduring and surpassing; 凌辱 includes insult and sexual assault but its full-word senses do not establish an infringement sense for 凌. Neither displayed label is settled as an answer to the other from these records; the suspected character-level infringement branch remains open.

dispositions.title: be ill; suffer
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 患: afflicted, disease, suffer from, be ill; JMdict 1212200 患う and 1212210 患者; 侵す 1359800 harm/afflict.
dispositions.reason: Suffering from an affliction and afflicting are related but not identical; guard broad affliction choices in both directions, not all illness/action usages.

dispositions.title: illness
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 病 ill/sick; JMdict 1490160 病, 1490210 病む, 1490230 病気; 侵す 1359800 afflict and cross-reference 冒す 1519820 disease-related harm.
dispositions.reason: 病む includes suffering from disease, while 侵す can afflict. Guard broad illness/affliction ambiguity in both directions; disease is not synonymous with invading or every harm.

dispositions.title: poison; venom
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 毒 includes harm/injury as well as poison; JMdict 1455500 毒 sense 2 harm/evil influence, 2083390 毒する, 1425160 中毒, 1221770 気の毒; 侵す 1359800 harm.
dispositions.reason: A harm branch is directly evidenced for both; protect both directions without claiming that every harm is poisoning or deriving compassion from the components of 気の毒.

dispositions.title: tear; break
dispositions.evidence: JMdict 1471200 破る sense 5 violate a rule, break a promise, infringe; sense 2 breach defenses; 1471300 破棄 and 1471450 破約 include breaking agreements; 侵す 1359800 violate/infringe.
dispositions.reason: The ordinary legal/rule violation branch warrants a direct guard in both directions; physical tearing is not equated with invasion. The separate 1208000 破る spelling for わる is search-only.

dispositions.title: divine fortunes; occupy
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 占 occupy/hold/take and fortune-telling; JMdict 1389460 占める occupy, 1389430 占う fortune-telling, 1389610 占領 military occupation/seizure; 侵す 1359800 invade/raid; 侵寇 is a whole word in target family.
dispositions.reason: Occupying or seizing a place is not automatically invading it, and 占領/侵寇 whole-word glosses do not prove constituent synonymy. The actual occupy and invade labels may still be confused in territorial contexts; this pair remains open pending stronger direct evidence.

dispositions.title: touch; contact
dispositions.evidence: JMdict 1357990 触れる sense 5 violate law/copyright or infringe; 1436280 抵触 infringement of law/treaty; 1357980 触る harmful/hinder; 侵す 1359800 infringe/violate.
dispositions.reason: Ordinary legal infringement is directly recorded, not only contact or a compound; protect both directions without equating all touching with trespass.

dispositions.title: differ
dispositions.evidence: JMdict 1158890 and 2008780 違える include breaking one's promise/word; 1158950 違反 violation/infringement, 1158930 違背 violation/transgression; 侵す 1359800 violate/infringe.
dispositions.reason: Rule or promise violation is supported independently beyond the differ title. Protect broad violation choices both ways, without treating every difference as infringement.

dispositions.title: thrust; sudden
dispositions.evidence: JMdict 1456890 突く includes attack, 1457000 突撃 assault/attack and 1457080 突入 breaking in; 侵す 1359800 raid/intrude.
dispositions.reason: The standalone verb has an attack sense and a raid can be an attack; guard the broad choice in either direction. Suddenness alone is not invasion and the whole compound 突入 does not prove each constituent means intrusion.

dispositions.title: penetrate; be thorough
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 徹 penetrate/pierce/clear/strike home; JMdict 1598340 徹する penetrate/sink in; 侵す 1359800 intrude, 1359850 侵入 includes penetration; Daijisen 侵 concerns unauthorized entry into another's domain.
dispositions.reason: English penetrate can describe entry, and intrusion involves unauthorized entry. Guard this broad entry/penetration choice in both directions; going through or being thorough is not always an intrusion, and 侵入's complete-word gloss is not transferred automatically to 侵.

dispositions.title: attack; discuss
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 討 attack/defeat/conquer; JMdict 1478010 討つ/撃つ/伐つ attack/conquer, 1449970 討伐 military subjugation; 侵す 1359800 raid.
dispositions.reason: A raid may be an attack; protect the displayed attack and invade/encroach choices in both directions without equating discussion or every attack with invasion.

dispositions.title: pain; hurt
dispositions.evidence: KANJIDIC2 痛 pain/hurt/damage/bruise; JMdict 1432710 痛む and 1432720 痛める including hurt, harm, damage and afflict; 侵す 1359800 harm/afflict.
dispositions.reason: Hurt is a defensible broad harm answer. Protect both directions without treating all pain and invasion as identical; 2519800's やめる aching sense is archaic and its sick sense restricted to 病める.
